name: Structure tests around observable behavior
statement: Name tests for the behavior and outcome, arrange isolated deterministic fixtures, assert observable contracts, and cover material failure and cancellation paths without timing-dependent waits.
rationale: Behavior-focused tests survive refactoring and give reviewers evidence about contracts rather than reproducing implementation details.

badExample.description: A timing-dependent test asserts an internal call
badExample.code: [Fact] public async Task Test1() { service.Start(); await Task.Delay(500); Assert.True(service.called); }

goodExample.description: The test states and observes the contract
goodExample.code: [Fact] public async Task ScanAsync_returns_unavailable_when_tool_is_missing() { var result = await scanner.ScanAsync(token); Assert.False(result.Available); }

history.change: Initial test-structure rule grounded in Quality Studio's xUnit suites and deterministic temporary repository fixtures.
